notes: Every entry is a kind-level disagreement between our engine and oasdiff that survived
folding oasdiff's catalog down to our 16 DifferenceKind codes. Cardinality differences
are invisible here on purpose: oasdiff addresses a finding per operation x status x media
type, we address it once per schema + property, so counts never match and comparing them
would produce permanent noise. See CURRENT-0002 for the full rationale of each row.
status=deliberate means the difference is intended. status=known-gap means the engine
disagrees with our own rule and the fix is still open.
